connector.name: Eco Van Move Booking
connector.registryDescription: Moving estimates, box rentals, and delivery in BC. Requires Eco Van Move account (OAuth or token).
connector.summary: Hosted at ecovanmove.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.ecovanmove, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from /account/mcp (personal access token or OAuth).
